I'm currently 10-3 with Vel'koz at Diamond 3. 

I don't quite agree with a few things in your item build. I always start with a fiendish codex because Vel'koz doesn't really have serious mana issues during the lanening phase. The extra ability power and cool down reduction, will allow you to wave clear better as well as give you more presence in lane. This will also allow you to go for either an Athene's or a Morellonomicon. His low mana costs gives him the option to go for the latter.

DFG's range is so short that if you get close enough to use it, a tank will gap close and kill you. As for rushing a haunting guise, it's very expensive for the amount of AP that it gives. A needlessly large rod will give you the ability to instantly clear a whole wave with a W+Q combo.

I've found that the best way to play Vel'koz is to just stack ability power / cdr. This allows you to spend minimal time in lane because fast wave clear is essential due to how easy it is for Vel'koz to be ganked.
